---
name: Design Proposal
about: Propose an implementation or public contract for an accepted problem.
title: "[Proposal] "
labels: proposal
assignees: ''
---

### Decision summary

State the proposed decision in a few sentences and link the problem it solves.

### Public contract

Show relevant Go APIs, protobuf definitions, configuration, commands, or wire
behavior. Keep the smallest interface that solves the problem.

### Compatibility and migration

Compare current Forge and Forge behavior. Describe source, behavior,
wire, toolchain, and release impact together with an executable migration path.

### Validation

Define correctness tests, race tests, integration tests, and performance
acceptance criteria before implementation begins.

### Alternatives

Explain why the standard library, an existing Forge API, upstream Kratos,
or a smaller change does not already solve the problem.
